units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 22. In the case provided for by part 9 of this Article, when a competition is held to fill the position of head of the local administration of a municipal raion, one quarter of the members of the competition commission shall be appointed by the representative body of the municipal raion, one quarter by the representative body of the settlement municipality that is the administrative centre of the municipal raion, and half by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 22 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 23. The powers provided for in parts 1–3 of Article 32 of this Federal Law shall be exercised in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation by local self-government bodies of rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities or local self-government bodies of municipal raions, unless otherwise provided by this Article, taking into account the specific features provided for in parts 5–16 of Article 32 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 24. The powers of local self-government bodies to adopt the charter of a municipality and amend and supplement it, issue municipal legal acts, establish official symbols of the municipality, draw up and consider the draft budget of the municipality, approve and execute the local budget, exercise municipal financial control, including control over execution of the budget of the municipality, draw up and approve the report on execution of the local budget in accordance with the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, possess, use and dispose of municipally owned property, and establish, bring into effect and terminate previously introduced local taxes and levies of the municipality in accordance with legislation on taxes and levies shall be exercised by local self-government bodies of rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions.
units.label: Part 24 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 25. Individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies for exercise shall be exercised by local self-government bodies of municipal raions, unless otherwise established by federal law or a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 26. Where, under the charter of a rural settlement municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, consideration of removal of the head of the municipality from office at a meeting of the representative body of the rural settlement municipality shall take place under the chairmanship of a deputy of the representative body of the rural settlement municipality authorized for that purpose by the representative body of that municipality. The decision on removal of the head of the municipality from office shall be signed by the deputy chairing the meeting of the representative body of the rural settlement municipality.
units.label: Part 26 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 27. Where, under the charter of a rural settlement municipality, the head of the municipality exercises the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality, the deputy elected head of the municipality and exercising their powers on a full-time basis under the charter of the municipality shall be counted when determining the number of deputies of the representative body of the municipality who may work on a full-time basis in accordance with part 12 of Article 25 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 27 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 28. In the event of early termination of the powers of the representative body of a municipal raion formed in accordance with point 1 of part 10 of this Article, the representative bodies of the corresponding settlement municipalities shall elect other deputies to the representative body of the municipal raion within one month.
units.label: Part 28 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 29. If all settlement municipalities forming part of a municipal raion are merged and a municipal okrug is formed in their territory, the municipal raion and those settlement municipalities shall be abolished.
units.label: Part 29 Art. 89

units.locator: Article 89. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization
units.text: 30. Specific features of the organization of local self-government in municipalities forming a two-tier system of local self-government organization that are not regulated by this Federal Law shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 30 Art. 89

units.locator: Chapter 11. Specific features of the exercise of powers by local self-government bodies in particular territories
units.text: Chapter 11. Specific features of the exercise of powers by local self-government bodies in particular territories
units.label: Chapter 11. Specific features of the exercise of powers by local self-government bodies in particular territories

units.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
units.text: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
units.label: Art. 90

units.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
units.text: 1. Local self-government bodies of municipalities whose territories are included in the list of northern-delivery territories shall exercise powers in the field of northern deliveries in accordance with Federal Law No. 411-ФЗ of 04.08.2023 “On Northern Deliveries”.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 90

units.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
units.text: 2. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall select suppliers (providers) of goods and services necessary to support the daily life of the population residing in northern-delivery territories for procuring entities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal procuring entities of municipalities located in those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, where a list of such goods and services is approved by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 90

units.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
units.text: 3. The list specified in part 2 of this Article may include socially significant food products, essential non-food consumer goods, medicinal products, medical devices, specialized therapeutic nutrition products, fuel and energy resources, fuels and lubricants, industrial and technical products and services related to their delivery. Other goods and services may not be included in that list.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 90

units.locator: Article 90. Specific features of organizing and carrying out northern deliveries in municipalities
units.text: 4. Procurement to meet municipal needs of other goods and services necessary to support the daily life of the population residing in northern-delivery territories but not included in the list specified in part 2 of this Article shall be carried out independently by local self-government bodies of municipalities, unless otherwise provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation on the contract system for procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 90

units.locator: Chapter 12. Final provisions
units.text: Chapter 12. Final provisions

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: Article 91. Final provisions
units.label: Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 1. Until 01.01.2028, local self-government bodies shall exercise powers in accordance with Articles 14–18 of Federal Law No. 131-ФЗ of 06.10.2003 “On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 2. Laws and other regulatory legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation regulating matters of local self-government organization and municipal legal acts shall be brought into conformity with this Federal Law no later than 01.01.2027. Until they are brought into conformity with this Federal Law, they shall apply to the relevant relations insofar as they do not contradict this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 3. From the date this Federal Law enters into force, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may be adopted establishing the territorial organization of local self-government in the corresponding constituent entity of the Russian Federation, with local self-government exercised in the types of municipalities specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of Article 9 of this Federal Law throughout the territory of the corresponding constituent entity of the Russian Federation or in the territory of an individual municipal raion.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 4. From the date of entry into force of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article that provides for local self-government to be exercised in the territory of a municipal raion in the types of municipalities specified in points 1 and 2 of part 2 of Article 9 of this Federal Law:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 1) new elections of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions elected at municipal elections and of deputies of representative bodies of settlement municipalities and municipal raions shall not be called or held, except for by-elections of deputies of the representative body of a municipality and elections of the head of a municipality provided for in point 2 of part 6 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 2) the representative bodies of rural settlement municipalities, urban settlement municipalities and municipal raions shall exercise their powers until expiry of the term of powers provided for by the charters of those municipalities.
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 5. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article shall provide for the formation of local self-government bodies in accordance with the new territorial organization of local self-government, taking into account expiry of the terms of powers of representative bodies of municipal raions or in connection with early termination of the powers of representative bodies of municipal raions.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 6. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may provide for:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 1) extension of the terms of powers of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions and representative bodies of settlement municipalities and municipal raions by no more than two years;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 2) election of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions, including the holding of elections of heads of settlement municipalities and municipal raions, for a term ending upon expiry of the term of powers of the representative body of the corresponding municipality;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 3) the possibility for local self-government bodies of a municipal raion to exercise the powers of local self-government bodies of settlement municipalities in the event of early termination of the powers of local self-government bodies of settlement municipalities;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 4) other matters connected with ensuring that the territorial organization of local self-government in the corresponding constituent entity of the Russian Federation is brought into conformity with the provisions of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 7. The powers of local self-government bodies of a settlement municipality or municipal raion whose term of powers has expired, including in the event of early termination of the powers of the corresponding local self-government bodies, shall be exercised by the local self-government bodies of the corresponding settlement municipalities and/or municipal raions until the formation of local self-government bodies of the newly formed municipalities.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 8. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may provide for the formation of a municipal okrug or urban okrug within boundaries coinciding with the territorial boundaries of a settlement municipality (rural or urban) or municipal raion existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force. If municipal and/or urban okrugs are formed within the boundaries of all settlement municipalities that formed part of the territory of a municipal raion, the municipal raion shall be abolished.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 9. A municipality formed under the procedure provided for by part 8 of this Article within boundaries coinciding with the territorial boundaries of a settlement municipality (rural or urban) existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force has the right, in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, to retain the name existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force, including a name indicating the type of municipality (urban or rural settlement municipality).
units.label: Part 9 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 10. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may, to ensure the development of social, transport and other infrastructure, provide for the formation of a municipality within boundaries combining the territories of several municipalities existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force or within other territorial boundaries, including a territory comprising part (parts) of the territory of the specified municipality (municipalities).
units.label: Part 10 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 11. The number of deputies of the representative body of the first convocation of a municipal okrug or urban okrug newly formed under the procedure provided for by this Article within boundaries coinciding with the territorial boundaries of a municipal raion existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force shall be established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. That number may not be fewer than the number of deputies of the representative body of the municipal raion existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 12. Where a municipal or urban okrug is formed under the procedure provided for by this Article within the boundaries of more than one settlement municipality existing on the date this Federal Law enters into force, territorial bodies of the local administration forming part of its structure shall be established in the administrative centres of those settlement municipalities.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 13. Where territorial bodies of the local administration are formed in accordance with part 12 of this Article and a person who held the position of head of a settlement municipality on the date this Federal Law enters into force is appointed head of a territorial body of the local administration, a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted in accordance with part 3 of this Article may provide for:
units.label: Part 13 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 1) a dual title for the position in the local administration, comprising a title determined with regard to historical and other local traditions for naming leadership positions in local self-government bodies and the title of the position of head of a territorial body of the local administration in accordance with the register of municipal service positions in the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and the procedure for using that dual title;
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 2) filling the position of head of a territorial body of the local administration without regard to the qualification requirements for the level of professional education established in accordance with Federal Law No. 25-ФЗ of 02.03.2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 14. A law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance may provide for extension by no more than two years of the terms of powers of heads of municipalities and representative bodies of intracity municipalities to ensure the simultaneous commencement of the exercise of powers of local self-government bodies established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is a city of federal significance regulating the territorial organization of local self-government and the status and powers of local self-government bodies of intracity municipalities, adopted in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 91. Final provisions
units.text: 15. Until expiry of the terms of powers of representative bodies of municipalities elected before 01.01.2027, the provisions of part 8 of Article 15, parts 4 and 16 of Article 19 and part 2 of Article 28 of this Federal Law shall not apply to heads of municipalities exercising the powers of chair of the representative body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 91

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.label: Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 1. Individual powers of local self-government bodies may be temporarily exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where, during the introduction of a special legal regime (including during martial law or in wartime), local self-government bodies are absent and cannot be formed in accordance with the procedure provided for by federal constitutional laws and this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 2. In the cases established by part 1 of this Article, the decision on temporary exercise by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of the corresponding powers of local self-government bodies shall be adopted by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. The decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on temporary exercise by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of individual powers of local self-government bodies shall contain:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 1) the name of the municipality or municipalities in which the exercise of individual powers of the local self-government bodies of those municipalities is temporarily entrusted to executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 2) the list of individual powers of local self-government bodies established by this Federal Law and other federal laws that are exercised by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 3) the list of executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and/or officials appointed by state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation entrusted with exercising individual powers of local self-government bodies, with the allocation of those powers among them;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 4) the period during which executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, which may not extend beyond the period until the circumstances provided for in part 1 of this Article are eliminated;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 5) the sources and procedure of financing the temporary exercise by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation of individual powers of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 3. The exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies temporarily exercised by executive authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with part 1 of this Article may, by decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, be entrusted to local self-government bodies of another municipality (other municipalities).
units.label: Part 3 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 4. The decree (resolution) of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation on temporary exercise by local self-government bodies of another municipality of individual powers of local self-government bodies shall contain:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 1) the name of the municipality (municipalities) or individual settlement (settlements) in which the exercise of individual powers of local self-government bodies is temporarily entrusted to local self-government bodies of another municipality;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 2) the list of individual powers of local self-government bodies established by this Federal Law and other federal laws that are exercised by local self-government bodies of another municipality, except for the powers of local self-government bodies to adopt the charter of a municipality, amend and supplement it, establish the structure of local self-government bodies, change the territorial boundaries of a municipality and reorganize a municipality;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 3) the period during which local self-government bodies of another municipality exercise individual powers of local self-government bodies, which may not extend beyond the period until the circumstances preventing the formation of local self-government bodies in accordance with federal constitutional laws and this Federal Law are eliminated;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 4) the sources and procedure of financing the temporary exercise by local self-government bodies of another municipality of individual powers of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 92

units.locator: Article 92. Specific features of the organization of local self-government where a special legal regime is introduced
units.text: 5. The powers of local self-government bodies to adopt the charter of a municipality, amend and supplement it, establish the structure of local self-government bodies, change the territorial boundaries of a municipality and reorganize a municipality may not be temporarily exercised by state authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, including by entrusting them to local self-government bodies of another municipality (other municipalities).
units.label: Part 5 Art. 92

units.text: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation

units.locator: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation

units.label: Part 1 Art. 93

units.text: 1) Chapters 1, 2, Article 18.1 and Chapters 4–12 of Federal Law No. 131-ФЗ of 06.10.2003 “On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation” (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2003, No. 40, item 3822);
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2) Article 4 of Federal Law No. 53-ФЗ of 19.06.2004 “On Amending Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation” (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2004, No. 25, item 2484);
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 3) Federal Law No. 99-ФЗ of 12.08.2004 “On Amending Article 82 of the Federal Law ‘On the Basic Guarantees of Electoral Rights and the Right of Citizens of the Russian Federation to Participate in a Referendum’ and Article 84 of the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’” (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2004, No. 33, item 3368);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 93

units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 5) Federal Law No. 186-ФЗ of 28.12.2004 “On Amending the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’” (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2005, No. 1, item 12);
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 6) Federal Law No. 34-ФЗ of 18.04.2005 “On Amending Article 85 of the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’” (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2005, No. 17, item 1480);
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 93

units.locator: Article 93. Repeal of individual legislative acts (provisions of legislative acts) of the Russian Federation
units.text: 7) Article 2 of Federal Law No. 69-ФЗ of 29.06.2005 “On Amending Article 80 of the Federal Law ‘On the Basic Guarantees of Electoral Rights and the Right of Citizens of the Russian Federation to Participate in a Referendum’ and Article 83 of the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’” (Collected Legislation of the Russian Federation, 2005, No. 27, item 2708);
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 93
